items.title: The economy brought Trump back to power. Now it's his downfall
items.body: Participants in the CNBC Voter Poll ranked the economy the most important issue facing the country, ahead of topics tied to democracy and immigration.

items.title: Analysis: The Democrats have one chance to extract concessions from Trump. Markets will hate it
items.body: The next debt-ceiling confrontation could reverse Washington's traditional political roles, raising the possibility of spending concessions, market volatility and a damaging default.

items.title: Private companies added 86,000 jobs in October, slightly higher than expected, ADP says
items.body: Private-sector job growth held steady in October, with gains spread across sectors

items.title: Euro zone inflation hits 4% for first time in three years as interest rate hike looms
items.body: It was driven by energy inflation, which surged above 20% in October.

items.title: Job openings posted big September gain in positive sign for labor market ahead of payrolls report
items.body: The BLS reported job openings at 7.52 million, up 333,000 from August and well above the Dow Jones consensus outlook for 7.15 million

items.title: Australia hikes rates to 18-year high to fight inflation
items.body: The Reserve Bank of Australia's decision was in line with expectations from economists polled by Reuters, and marked its fifth rate increase this year.

items.title: South Korea targets 'world's highest performance' sovereign AI model in record new budget
items.body: The 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, and will include a 21.3 trillion won investment into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.

items.title: Euro zone economy slows to 0.4% growth in Q3 as crisis-hit France contracts
items.body: The euro zone showed surprising resilience, but weak productivity, industrial competitiveness challenges and demographic pressures remain, analysts said.
